entities.summary: Yeşilli is a municipality and district of Mardin Province, Turkey. Its area is 168 km2, and its population is 13,621 (2022). It is the smallest district in the province by population and by area. The district was created in 1990 from parts of the former central district of Mardin Province and of Ömerli district.
